name: AI-Powered Website SEO Health Check
problem: Small/family-owned businesses run websites with unaddressed technical and on-page SEO issues (outdated templates, no content strategy) and no in-house marketing team to catch it.
target_buyer: Independent retail/service businesses, 1-5 locations, no in-house marketer.

evidence.claim: Fiverr lead-gen/research adjacent categories have real, active buyers
evidence.source: Fiverr b2b-sales category listing, 1970 active services

evidence.claim: Faller's Furniture (real site) has 6 concrete, fixable SEO issues
SEO audit delivery has no paid-tool dependency, unlike lead-list verification
evidence.source: Reasoned from Hunter.io free-tier cap (50 credits/month) research

competitors: Many Fiverr/Upwork SEO audit sellers - exact count not verified
acquisition_channels: Manual personalized outreach to researched prospects
human_involvement: Outreach sending, order acceptance, payment, final QC sign-off before delivery - all require human action for platform ToS / trust / legal reasons.
legal_platform_risk: Low for delivery (public HTML analysis of a site to audit it for a report is standard SEO practice). Outreach sending must stay under Gmail safe limits (~10-25/day) and Upwork/Fiverr require human-submitted proposals.
scalability: High - delivery has no free-tier bottleneck, unlike lead-gen.
first_customer_difficulty: MEDIUM - real competition on Fiverr, but low price point + genuine personalization should offset it.
next_action: Owner approval of outreach drafts, then send.

name: B2B Lead List & Research Service
problem: Sales teams need targeted prospect lists with verified contact info.

evidence.claim: Hunter.io free tier caps at 50 credits/month (shared find+verify pool)
evidence.source: Hunter.io pricing pages, multiple sources, checked 2026

next_action: Revisit once SEO experiment funds a paid email-finder tier.
